pass: Deep thanks aimed at the boy himself, not only at his mother. A pledge to repay or serve him: a lasting debt, not a passing thank-you. Formal even to a child (young master, a bow), with feeling shown under restraint.

earlier: Last night Edda ordered Mira out of the house.
Aldo spoke up at the family meeting and talked his mother round: Mira may stay, and raise her child here.
memory: 1. I always thought the boy was uncanny and kept my distance from him.
2. I am carrying Master Bran's child, and I had nowhere to go.
